combo1.title: Speedroid Terrortop into M-X-Saber Invoker: Double Claudius and Heraklinos
combo1.description: A one-card line from Speedroid Terrortop, with one more card to discard to Flavian. Terrortop and Taketomborg make M-X-Saber Invoker, which brings Gladiator Beast Attorix from the Deck. Test Panther then searches Flavian - Colosseum of the Gladiator Beasts, and a Tri-Brigade engine (Arms Mouser, Kitt, Nervall, Springans Kitt, Shuraig) finds Test Bear. Test Bear summons Gistel and Noxious, which fetch Gladiator Beast's Comeback and set up Vespasius, and those become Tamer Editor. Editor brings out Claudius, and a revived Editor brings out Heraklinos. A second Claudius comes from its own summoning procedure, and Flavian Sets Gladiator Beast Charge in the End Phase. End board: two Claudius (the second can conduct your next Battle Phase twice), Heraklinos with Fraktall and three Triple Tactics Thrust in hand as discards for its negate, and Tri-Brigade Nervall. Starting hand: Speedroid Terrortop + Triple Tactics Talent + 3 Triple Tactics Thrust. The replay's Talent and Thrusts do nothing going first, so any card works as Flavian's discard.

cards.name: Flavian - Colosseum of the Gladiator Beasts

steps.text: Special Summon Speedroid Terrortop from your hand. You control no monsters, so it can summon itself.
Activate effect: Speedroid Terrortop was Special Summoned. Add a Speedroid from your Deck.
Add Speedroid Taketomborg to your hand.
Special Summon Speedroid Taketomborg from your hand. You control a WIND monster, so it can summon itself.
Xyz Summon M-X-Saber Invoker (2 Level 3 monsters).
Speedroid Taketomborg becomes Xyz Material.
Speedroid Terrortop becomes the second material.

Activate effect: M-X-Saber Invoker. Detach 1 material to summon a Level 4 EARTH Warrior or Beast-Warrior from your Deck in Defense Position. It is destroyed in the End Phase, but it will be gone long before then.
Detach Speedroid Terrortop as the cost.
Special Summon Gladiator Beast Attorix, a Level 4 EARTH Beast-Warrior, in Defense Position. Invoker isn't a Gladiator Beast, so Attorix's trigger doesn't activate.
Gladiator Beast Attorix and M-X-Saber Invoker will become Test Panther's materials. Invoker's last material, Speedroid Taketomborg, goes to the Graveyard with it.
Gladiator Beast Attorix becomes Link Material.
M-X-Saber Invoker becomes Link Material.
Link Summon Test Panther (2 monsters, including a Gladiator Beast monster).
Activate effect: Test Panther's on-summon effect. Add a Gladiator Beast card from your Deck.
Add Flavian - Colosseum of the Gladiator Beasts to your hand.
Activate Flavian - Colosseum of the Gladiator Beasts.
Activate effect: Flavian. Discard 1 card to add a Gladiator Beast monster from your Deck.
Discard Triple Tactics Talent as the cost. It needs your opponent to have used a monster effect, so going first it is a free discard.
Add Gladiator Beast Gistel to your hand.
Normal Summon Gladiator Beast Gistel.

Activate effect: Test Panther. Target Gistel: shuffle it into the Deck and bring out a Gladiator Beast with a different original name from your Deck. This counts as a Special Summon by a Gladiator Beast monster's effect.
Shuffle Gladiator Beast Gistel into the Deck.
Special Summon Gladiator Beast Darius from your Deck in Defense Position.

Activate effect: Gladiator Beast Darius was summoned by a Gladiator Beast's effect. Revive a Gladiator Beast from your Graveyard. Its effects are negated, and it shuffles into the Deck when Darius leaves the field.
Special Summon Gladiator Beast Attorix from your Graveyard in Defense Position.
Activate effect: Gladiator Beast Attorix. It was summoned by a Gladiator Beast's effect, and its cost is sending a Gladiator Beast from your Deck to the Graveyard.
Send Gladiator Beast Equeste from your Deck to the Graveyard as the cost. Darius negates the rest of the effect, so Attorix keeps its own name and Level, but Equeste is in the Graveyard for later.
Gladiator Beast Attorix becomes Link Material. It leaves before Darius does, so it isn't shuffled away.
Test Panther becomes Link Material.

Link Summon Tri-Brigade Arms Mouser (2 Beast, Beast-Warrior and/or Winged Beast monsters). For the rest of the turn, only Beast, Beast-Warrior and Winged Beast monsters can come out of your Extra Deck.
Activate effect: Tri-Brigade Arms Mouser's on-summon effect. Send 2 Tri-Brigade cards with different names from your Deck to the Graveyard.
Send Tri-Brigade Kitt to the Graveyard.
Send Tri-Brigade Nervall to the Graveyard.
Activate effect: Tri-Brigade Nervall was sent to the Graveyard (Chain Link 1). Add a Tri-Brigade monster from your Deck.
Activate effect: Tri-Brigade Kitt was sent to the Graveyard (Chain Link 2). Send another Tri-Brigade card from your Deck to the Graveyard.
Chain Link 2 resolves: send Tri-Brigade Springans Kitt to the Graveyard.
Chain Link 1 resolves: add Tri-Brigade Fraktall to your hand.
Activate effect: Tri-Brigade Springans Kitt was sent to the Graveyard. Revive a Tri-Brigade monster from your Graveyard in Defense Position.
Special Summon Tri-Brigade Nervall in Defense Position.

Activate effect: Tri-Brigade Nervall. Banish Beast, Beast-Warrior and Winged Beast monsters from your Graveyard to bring out a Link Monster with the same Link Rating. For the rest of the turn, only those three Types can be Link Material.
Banish Tri-Brigade Springans Kitt.
Banish Tri-Brigade Kitt.
Banish Test Panther.
Banish Gladiator Beast Attorix. That's 4.
Special Summon Tri-Brigade Shuraig the Ominous Omen (Link-4) from your Extra Deck, to a zone Arms Mouser points to.
Tri-Brigade Shuraig the Ominous Omen becomes Link Material.
Tri-Brigade Arms Mouser becomes Link Material.
Link Summon Tri-Brigade Ferrijit the Barren Blossom (2 Beast, Beast-Warrior and/or Winged Beast monsters).

Activate effect: Tri-Brigade Shuraig the Ominous Omen was sent to the Graveyard. Add a Beast, Beast-Warrior or Winged Beast monster whose Level is no higher than the number of those monsters you have banished (4).
Add Test Bear (Level 4) to your hand.
Special Summon Test Bear from your hand in Defense Position. You control Darius, a Gladiator Beast Special Summoned from the Deck, so it can summon itself.

Activate effect: Test Bear. Tribute it, then shuffle a Gladiator Beast from your hand or field into the Deck to Special Summon up to 2 Gladiator Beast monsters from your Deck. This counts as a Special Summon by a Gladiator Beast's effect.
Tribute Test Bear as the cost.
Shuffle Gladiator Beast Darius into the Deck.
Special Summon Gladiator Beast Gistel from your Deck in Defense Position.
Special Summon Gladiator Beast Noxious from your Deck in Defense Position.
Activate effect: Gladiator Beast Gistel (Chain Link 1). Add a Gladiator Spell/Trap from your Deck.
Activate effect: Gladiator Beast Noxious (Chain Link 2). Send a Gladiator Beast monster from your Deck to the Graveyard.
Chain Link 2 resolves: send Gladiator Beast Vespasius to the Graveyard.
Chain Link 1 resolves: add Gladiator Beast's Comeback to your hand.

Activate Gladiator Beast's Comeback. It revives a Gladiator Beast whose Type differs from every monster you control: Vespasius is a Sea Serpent, and you control Beasts, a Beast-Warrior and a Winged Beast.
Special Summon Gladiator Beast Vespasius from your Graveyard.
Gladiator Beast's Comeback goes to the Graveyard.
Gladiator Beast Noxious (Level 5) shuffles into the Deck as one of Tamer Editor's materials.
Gladiator Beast Vespasius (Level 7) shuffles into the Deck as the other.
Contact Fusion: Special Summon Gladiator Beast Tamer Editor by shuffling 2 Level 5 or higher Gladiator Beast monsters you control into the Deck.
Activate effect: Gladiator Beast Tamer Editor. Special Summon another Gladiator Beast from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions.

Special Summon Gladiator Beast Claudius. It wasn't summoned its own way, so it doesn't get the double Battle Phase, but its Quick Effect works: once per turn, when your opponent activates a monster effect on their turn, it brings out a Level 11 or lower Gladiator Beast from your Extra Deck.
Gladiator Beast Tamer Editor becomes Link Material.
Tri-Brigade Ferrijit the Barren Blossom becomes Link Material.
Link Summon Gladiator Beast Dareios (2 monsters, including a Gladiator Beast).

Activate effect: Gladiator Beast Dareios's on-summon effect (Chain Link 1). Special Summon a Level 4 or lower Gladiator Beast from your hand or Graveyard. For the rest of the turn, only Gladiator Beast monsters can be Link Material.
Activate effect: Tri-Brigade Ferrijit the Barren Blossom was sent to the Graveyard (Chain Link 2). Draw 1 card, then place 1 card from your hand on the bottom of the Deck.
Draw 1 card: Gladiator Beast Vespasius.
Place Gladiator Beast Vespasius on the bottom of the Deck.
Chain Link 1 resolves: Special Summon Gladiator Beast Equeste from your Graveyard in Defense Position.
Activate effect: Gladiator Beast Equeste was summoned by a Gladiator Beast's effect. Add a Gladiator Beast card from your Graveyard to your hand.
Add Gladiator Beast's Comeback back to your hand.
Gladiator Beast Equeste becomes Link Material.
Gladiator Beast Dareios becomes Link Material.
Link Summon Gladiator Beast Dragases (2 Gladiator Beast monsters).
Activate Gladiator Beast's Comeback again. Tamer Editor is a Beast-Warrior, and now you only control Beasts and Winged Beasts.
Special Summon Gladiator Beast Tamer Editor from your Graveyard. It was summoned properly earlier, so it can be revived.
Gladiator Beast's Comeback goes to the Graveyard.
Activate effect: Gladiator Beast Tamer Editor. It is a new card on the field, so its once-per-turn effect is available again.

Special Summon Gladiator Beast Heraklinos from your Extra Deck, ignoring its Summoning conditions. It can discard a card to negate a Spell or Trap activation, and you still hold Fraktall and three Triple Tactics Thrust to discard.
Gladiator Beast Gistel becomes Link Material.
Gladiator Beast Tamer Editor becomes Link Material.
Link Summon a second Gladiator Beast Dareios to a zone Dragases points to. Its summon effect has already been used this turn.
The second Gladiator Beast Dareios returns from the field to the Extra Deck as one of Claudius's 5 materials.
Gladiator Beast Dragases returns from the field to the Extra Deck.
Gladiator Beast Gistel shuffles from your Graveyard into the Deck.
The first Gladiator Beast Dareios returns from your Graveyard to the Extra Deck.
Gladiator Beast Equeste shuffles from your Graveyard into the Deck. That makes 5.
Contact Fusion: Special Summon a second Gladiator Beast Claudius by shuffling 5 Gladiator Beast monsters from your field and Graveyard into the Deck and Extra Deck. This one is summoned its own way.
Activate effect: Gladiator Beast Claudius was summoned its own way, so you can conduct your next Battle Phase twice.
Activate effect: Flavian - Colosseum of the Gladiator Beasts in the End Phase. A Gladiator Beast was Special Summoned from your Deck this turn, so Set a Gladiator Trap from your Deck.

Set Gladiator Beast Charge. End board: two Gladiator Beast Claudius, Gladiator Beast Heraklinos and Tri-Brigade Nervall, with Flavian and a Set Gladiator Beast Charge, which destroys a face-up card for each differently named Gladiator Beast you control.
